b/ Class work is for 5 hours a day, 25 days a month, 10 months a year. Practical work is for 8 hours a day, 25 days a month, 10 months a year.
tot: Summed the class-work hours in each column: A-I 2,000 (printed 2,000, agree); A-II 1,250 (printed 1,250, agree); B 800 (printed 800, agree); C 1,000 (printed 1,000, agree). Practical work: A-I 1,600+400+600+200 = 2,800; A-II 1,200+200+600 = 2,000; B 200+200+600 = 1,000; C 800+200+600 = 1,600; all agree with Total Practical Work. Total Work: 2,000+2,800 = 4,800; 1,250+2,000 = 3,250; 800+1,000 = 1,800; 1,000+1,600 = 2,600; all agree. Months also agree (16+14 = 30; 10+10 = 20; 6+5 = 11; 8+8 = 16). For Sociology/Economics the single printed 40 in each of A-II, B and C was counted once.
